# Total Dental Solution

> A comprehensive full-service dental clinic led by Dr. Rajendra Desai offering implants, cosmetic dentistry, laser therapy, and advanced diagnostic technology in Bardoli, Surat, India.

Total Dental Solution is a modern dental practice featuring state-of-the-art equipment including digital panoramic X-ray technology and EPIC diode laser systems. The clinic specializes in restorative, cosmetic, and surgical dental procedures with a focus on patient education and minimally-invasive treatment approaches.

## Core Services & Facilities

- [Services](https://www.totaldentalsolution.com/services): Complete dental services including implants, cosmetic dentistry, laser therapy, and restorative procedures
- [Guided Biofilm Therapy](https://www.totaldentalsolution.com/guided-biofilm-therapy): Swiss Guided Biofilm Therapy for minimally-invasive gum disease treatment
- [Epic Laser](https://www.totaldentalsolution.com/epic-laser): EPIC 10 diode laser for soft tissue surgery and periodontal therapy
- [Digital Panoramic X-Ray Unit](https://www.totaldentalsolution.com/digital-panoramic-xray-unit): CRANEX NOVUS digital panoramic X-ray equipment and advanced diagnostic technology
- [Treatment Gallery](https://www.totaldentalsolution.com/gallery): Before-and-after gallery showcasing dental treatments and smile transformations
